caveats: Coverage is conceptual; the checklist is not mechanically applicable from inside fab today.
claims.text: The 20-flag checklist covers all three contract attention boundaries (no-train-without-permission, no-private-eval-leakage, no-FP-reduction-by-suppression) with concrete trigger conditions, plus public-metric shortcutting, weak labels, embedding tautology, reproduction debt, statistical hygiene, and distribution coverage.

Applied to ws_001 pkt_001, the checklist triggers F12 (single-rater, anticipatory), F14 (unspecified stability axis), and unknown-status on F13 (embedding tautology) and F19 (stratification). These are the same gaps surfaced by the cluster-stability critique and the pre-registered labeling plan, expressed in a comparable form.

Applied to the seeded ws_003 pkt_001, the checklist triggers F5 (FP drop with target-detection drop, already self-flagged) and F8 (public-metric shortcutting; 'public_refusal_fp_v1' is named public in provenance).
